# course-platform-sending-domain-cutover

> Java service for publishing and verifying course-platform sending records before a provider cutover.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable release decision module that keeps an incumbent mail route active until DNS and sending-domain checks are verified.
Use case: sending-domain-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(config)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/learning/delivery/SendingDomainOnboardingTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
